summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to follow the current Meridale pages: canonical tz (links and UTC offsets mapped to Etc/GMT zones), half-open to date, BCP 47 locale with fallback, no deprecated params, Decimal rounding to currency digits, and locale-aware dashboard text. The rounding page says ties go half up but the changelog says half to even since 2026-08-17; I used half even, so that choice is worth confirming.
